verdicts.rationale: [keep/high] Companies House shows TAYLOR & FRANCIS LIMITED (00314578) as dormant (SIC 99999), with dormant-company accounts filed every year up to 31 Dec 2025, so it cannot have been the supplier on 2025–26 notices. The PPON names 'INFORMA UK LIMITED, TRADING AS TAYLOR & FRANCIS GROUP', and Informa UK Limited is a separate trading company (01072954), so this PPON belongs to Informa UK and not to the dormant company number. | challenger: The reviewer's facts hold on the register. TAYLOR & FRANCIS LIMITED (00314578) is SIC 99999 and filed dormant-company accounts to 31 Dec 2024 and 31 Dec 2025, with no previous names. INFORMA UK LIMITED (01072954) is a separate active publishing company at the same 5 Howick Place office, so the PPON-side name 'INFORMA UK LIMITED, TRADING AS TAYLOR & FRANCIS GROUP' names a different legal entity that trades under the T&F brand. The 3 witnesses carry 00314578 as the primary identifier, which suggests the registrant wrote the dormant company's number, but a dormant company is not the supplier. Nothing on the register or in the names shows the PPON is 00314578's, so this is a wrong number, not a rename or a trading name of it.

[needs-more-evidence/medium; challenger: merge/high] The PPON's head and main name is 'THE AD CONSTRUCTION GROUP LIMITED', which is the exact legal name of the parent holding company 04405362 (SIC 70100 head office, same Sidcup address), while 9 witnesses pair the PPON with the subsidiary Architectural Decorators Ltd (00386730), which trades as 'AD Construction Group'. Two things would settle it: whether any notice pairs this PPON with 04405362, and which name the 9 witness notices give for the party. | challenger: The reviewer's first settling question is already answered: ppon_partners=1, so no FTS notice pairs PRWG-4976-HYXL with 04405362, and all 9 witnesses carry 00386730 as the primary identifier. The PPON side also publishes 'Architectural Decorators Limited', the register's exact current name. THE AD CONSTRUCTION GROUP LIMITED's June 2025 group accounts (filed with Companies House) show it is a holding company whose own balance sheet is investments. Its only trading subsidiary is Architectural Decorators Limited (85.72%, building maintenance and refurbishment); the other two consolidated subsidiaries are dormant, and a 50% one is not controlled. The group brands itself 'The AD Construction Group', matching the COH-side 'AD Construction Group (Architectural Decorators Ltd)', so the parent-name head is the group brand of the one company doing the work. I could not see the witness notices' own party names, but they would not change which company number the PPON carries.

[needs-more-evidence/medium; challenger: merge/high] The PPON's head is 'Vacuum Furnace Engineering Ltd', and Companies House shows that as a separate active trading company (01920664, full accounts to Dec 2024) held by the same Busch family, so it is a sister of Busch (UK) Ltd. Against it are only 1 witness and one 'Busch (UK) Ltd trading as Vacuum Furnace Engineering' name; VFE Ltd's 2025 accounts showing a hive-up into Busch UK, or a notice pairing this PPON with 01920664, would settle it. | challenger: The reviewer's 'sister company' premise is wrong: VACUUM FURNACE ENGINEERING LIMITED's confirmation statement of 1 Oct 2025 lists BUSCH (UK) LIMITED as holder of all 100 shares; the PSC register showing the Busch siblings is out of date. Busch (UK) Ltd's 2025 group strategic report (filed 17 Jul 2026) says that during 2025 it 'fully integrated our Vacuum Furnace Engineering subsidiary into the Busch (UK) Ltd legal entity'. That is the hive-up the reviewer said would settle it, and it matches the PPON name 'Busch (UK) Ltd trading as Vacuum Furnace Engineering'. With ppon_partners=1 (the PPON is never published with 01920664), the 'Vacuum Furnace Engineering Ltd' head is the business's former name, now a trading name of Busch (UK) Ltd.

[needs-more-evidence/medium; challenger: merge/medium] The PPON's names split between 'Heatons Group Ltd' (the register's company) and its first-seen head 'D3 office group'. Companies House shows D3 OFFICE GROUP LIMITED (03597932, Hull, owned by Stratsource Ltd) is an unrelated competitor, not connected to Heatons (PSC David Heaton Fielding), and there is only 1 witness. The PPON's Central Digital Platform registered name, or a count of notices under each name, would settle whose PPON it is. | challenger: The PPON's register-side name 'Heatons Group Ltd' is a form variant of HEATONS GROUP LIMITED (01995153, previously Heatons Office Solutions / Heaton Stationery) and comes from a witness-free notice. It agrees with witness 061889-2026, which publishes Heatons' own company number with this PPON, and the listing shows ppon_partners=1 and cooccurring=0: the PPON never pairs with D3's number 03597932 and never stands beside Heatons as a separate party. I re-checked Companies House: D3 OFFICE GROUP LIMITED (03597932, Hull, owned by Stratsource Ltd / the Shaw family, SIC wholesale of office furniture) is unrelated to Heatons (Wirral, PSC David Heaton Fielding). An unrelated supplier in the same trade winning the first-seen head is the same mislabelled-stray pattern as the Amentum/Altrad Babcock precedent in issue 448, so it points to D3 as the stray rather than D3 as the PPON's owner. Confidence is only medium because the listing has no per-name notice counts.

[needs-more-evidence/medium; challenger: merge/medium] The PPON's names split between the register's OMFAX SYSTEMS LIMITED and its first-seen head 'CRS Communications'. Companies House shows CRS COMMUNICATIONS LIMITED (06455449, Leeds, owned by French/Strauss) is unrelated to Omfax (owned by Omfax Limited, Bicester), and there is only 1 witness. The PPON's CDP registered name or a per-name notice count would settle it; the register-form uppercase name leans toward Omfax but does not make it plain. | challenger: The PPON's other name 'OMFAX SYSTEMS LIMITED' is the register's exact current name, in capitals as registered (the same shape as AMENTUM CLEAN ENERGY LIMITED in the Amentum precedent), and it comes from a witness-free notice. It agrees with witness 069684-2025, which publishes Omfax's own number 02163369 with this PPON, and ppon_partners=1 shows the PPON never pairs with CRS's number 06455449. I re-checked Companies House: CRS COMMUNICATIONS LIMITED (06455449, Guiseley, Leeds, PSCs French/Strauss, SIC 33140 repair of electrical equipment) is unrelated to Omfax, whose parent is Omfax Limited 02171672, itself owned by Touch-Base Limited. That makes the first-seen head 'CRS Communications' one supplier from a related sector filed under Omfax's PPON, a single stray, which the rubric says is not a reason to hold the pair; the reviewer also conceded the registered-form name leans toward Omfax. Confidence is medium only because per-name notice counts are missing.
